chunks: From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ammar ibn Marwan, from Abu Asama Zayd al-Shahham, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The people were commanded with two characteristics, but they wasted them, so they became from them upon nothing. (These two are) patience and concealment.'

key_terms.الصَّبْرُ: Patience, perseverance in the face of hardship

ai.seo_question: What are the two characteristics that people wasted according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights patience (sabr) and concealment (kitman) as the two neglected virtues that led to the people's spiritual decline, a concept central to the Shia doctrine of *al-kitman* (concealment of truth during times of persecution). This hadith underscores the strategic and spiritual necessity of guarding one's inner beliefs and enduring external pressures with quiet resilience, particularly relevant to the era of the Imams' political struggles.
